# Aureole Pharma Tech
> Pharmaceutical engineering manufacturer in Nashik, Maharashtra, India. Makes stability chambers, walk-in chambers, incubators, freezers, ovens, table-top instruments, cleanroom equipment and modular laboratory furniture, with monitoring software and service support.

Contact: enquiry@aureolepharmatech.com | +91 86005 22240
Offices: Nashik (Office No. 6004, Satyanarayan Mall, Lawate Nagar) and Thane (Unit 103, Centura Square, Wagale Industrial Estate).
Managing Director: Dr. Kiran Badgujar.
Fuller factual overview: https://www.aureolepharmatech.com/content.md
